name: unicity-arcade
description: Free-to-play browser multiplayer arcade on Unicity, gated by the Sphere wallet.

scripts.verify:build: tsc src/games/tictactoe/engine.ts src/games/chess/ai.ts src/games/match3/engine.ts src/games/runner/generator.ts --outDir .verify --rootDir src/games --module esnext --target es2022 --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck
scripts.verify:ai: npm run verify:build && node scripts/verify-ttt-ai.mjs && node scripts/verify-chess-ai.mjs && node scripts/verify-match3.mjs && node scripts/verify-runner.mjs
